title: Claude Code: Plugins overview
summary: A plugin is a directory of components, usually with a manifest at .claude-plugin/plugin.json: skills, agents, settings hooks, a hooks module (which makes it a mod), MCP servers, output styles and more. Plugins come from marketplaces (a repository with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json) or load from a folder with --plugin-dir. Scopes are user, project and local. A cloud session, including claude.ai/code, doesn't load the plugins in local settings; a project adds plugins for its cloud threads in Project settings.
ideas: One plugin can carry the mod, a skill for avenMAIA and an MCP server together.
A repository can be its own marketplace, so theOS can ship its mod from theOS/.
Cloud sessions need a plugin added on the account or project, not in the repository's settings.

took.idea: Ship the mod, a skill and later an MCP server as one plugin in theOS
